shorts_extract.hook: Face to face, head-injury survivor D.S. insists his parents are identical impostors while his fingertip sweat trace stays completely flat — yet over the phone he recognizes them instantly.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Hirstein & Ramachandran (1997) skin-conductance test + telephone dissociation proving intact fusiform face recognition severed from the amygdala.
shorts_extract.twist: Capgras is the exact mirror image of face blindness, plus a second right-frontal belief-checking injury (Coltheart's two-factor model).
